answer: Rotation is recorded in the shale index and the wander audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 419 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the ledge beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 29 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
